headline: Lees-McRae go thirteen wins and three draws without defeat
dek: Lees-McRae won at Belmont Abbey and still have not lost this season. They have thirteen wins and three draws, and Young Harris come next.
displaced_by: results night: Lees-McRae's win at Belmont Abbey keeps them unbeaten through sixteen matches
